claim.scope_statement: For any number field K, every nontrivial irreducible finite-image Artin representation induced from a one-dimensional character over a finite extension has an entire L-function. In particular all nontrivial irreducible representations with finite dihedral image satisfy the literal conjecture. The analytic inputs are Artin induction compatibility and Hecke holomorphy; no nonmonomial case is proved.
